polylogue-did06.description:
## Problem

`ProjectionSemanticFacts` and `build_projection_semantic_facts` have no production consumer. They were introduced with the older projection branch, and the current source tree has no caller outside their defining modules. Their retained protocols, model, exports, and test preserve a parallel semantic shape without a live read or rendering route.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Remove `ProjectionSemanticFacts`, `build_projection_semantic_facts`, and projection-only supporting protocols and exports.
2. Remove their dedicated test and fixtures.
3. Confirm the current production tree has no caller outside the deleted implementation before removal.
4. Preserve live session, message, summary, stream, and MCP semantic facts.
5. Verify the affected semantic-facts tests through `devtools test` and the complete managed gate.

## Scope

This is a WS-F F6 dead-surface slice, discovered while recovering the clean `wave-f-dead-surface` lane. It is separate from the active read-algebra program: no replacement surface is added.
polylogue-did06.title: Retire orphaned projection semantic facts

polylogue-ojbn6.description:
## Problem

`read_mcp_call` is an isolated direct lookup over `mcp_call_log`. The current production tree has no caller. Live MCP-call access uses the filtered listing route, so the unused lookup and its narrow tests maintain an unexercised public-shaped API.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Confirm no current production caller exists outside the function definition.
2. Remove `read_mcp_call` and tests that exist solely for it.
3. Preserve `list_mcp_calls` and the session-ref listing behavior used by live routes.
4. Verify affected ops-tier tests through `devtools test` and the complete managed gate.

## Scope

This is a WS-F F6 dead-surface slice, discovered while recovering the clean `wave-f-dead-surface` lane. It does not alter the stored MCP-call schema or live list/query behavior.
polylogue-ojbn6.title: Retire unused direct MCP-call lookup
